meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用 Azure CLI 或自带脚本查询 Azure 订阅的配额(服务限制)与用量,返回各资源的配额上限、当前用量和可用余量;也能对比区域、申请提升配额。
howto.when: 当你提到“查配额”“服务限制”“申请提升配额”等,或做部署容量规划、选区域时触发。

say.text: 查一下 eastus 区域 Microsoft.Compute 的配额和用量。
say.note: 脚本会返回该资源提供程序的配额、用量和可用余量。

say.text: 对比 eastus、westus2 两地的 vCPU 配额余量。
say.note: Claude 会逐区域查询并比较可用容量。

say.text: 帮我把 standardDSv3Family 配额提升到 500。
say.note: 提交配额提升申请并查询状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude queries Azure subscription quotas (service limits) and usage via Azure CLI or bundled scripts, returning limit, current usage, and available capacity for each resource. It can also compare regions and request quota increases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention checking quotas, service limits, or requesting increases, or when planning deployments, validating capacity, or selecting Azure regions.

say_en.text: Check quota and usage for Microsoft.Compute in eastus.
say_en.note: Returns quota, usage, and available capacity for that provider.

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quota headroom between eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Queries each region and compares available capacity.
Submits the increase request and checks its status.
